text:
ania: Quick thread 1: need a compact benchmark narrative + two visuals (savings matrix + tail-latency scatter) and a gated calculator. target: devs who self-serve, and infra buyers.
chris: Savings matrix idea: rows = workload shapes (burst, steady, conversational), cols = knobs (batching, kv-cache, quant). cells show % cost reduction vs baseline. super scannable.
vijay: Scatter = p95 latency (ms) on x, $/1k requests on y. color by model family. annotate a point where caching+batching hits the best tradeoff.
kai: UX: CTA buttons per audience: "Try API" (devs), "Request ROI review" (infra buyers), "Partner pilot". Signup asks monthly tokens -> routing buckets.
benchbot: data export: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/1769999991 -> file bench-matrix-v1.csv (burst/steady/conv workloads, q8/q4/no-quant).
ania: Copy hooks: headline "Turn latency into predictable dollars." one-liner: "See how batching, caching, and quantization change your token bill." social hook: "Which workloads save the most? Try our calculator."
chris: Visuals: use a simple 3x3 matrix PNG for quick share, and high-res scatter for the blog. export PNG 1200x630 and SVG for blog.
vijay: Calculator: spreadsheet template + API endpoint example. curl example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/estimate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens_per_min":2000,"workload":"burst","batch":16}'```
kai: Routing: form field "tokens_monthly" -> tags: <50k (self-serve), 50k-500k (nurture), >500k (sales). marketing to flag with 'bench_interest'. ops to validate CRM mapping.
ania: Timeline proposal: wireframes + data by Thu, visuals Fri, gated sheet + page Mon, live webinar two weeks out. owners: chris visuals, vijay numbers & calc, kai routing, ania copy.
chris: I'll drop Figma link Fri AM.
vijay: I'll push the kneepoint numbers and CSV by Wed.
kai: I can prototype the form and Zap routing by Mon staging.
ania: Nice. small asks: call out uncertainty band on scatter, include microcopy on calculator: "Estimates assume steady state; spikes change tail latency." we'll reconvene Wed if needed. :rocket:
